In Hindu mythology, Ganga is also associated with the god Shiva, who brought the river down from the heavens to earth as a form of blessing to mankind. The name Gangadatt may therefore be seen as a connection to these powerful Hindu beliefs and symbols, and a reminder of the importance of the river Ganga in Hindu culture and spirituality.
